description:
## Why (revised 2026-05-11 after code-state audit)

Original framing of this epic ("build the verify pipeline from scratch") was wrong. The pipeline is mostly shipped. After auditing the workspace, what actually exists:

- **`pkix_chain::verify_chain()`** at `pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:156–184` — fully implemented. Path build via path-builder, RFC 5280 §6.1 path validation via `pkix_path::validate_path`, per-cert revocation via `RevocationChecker` trait. Returns `Result<ValidatedPath, Error>`.
- **`verify_chain_default()`** at `pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:108–118` — convenience wrapper plugging in `DefaultVerifier`.
- **`pkix-chain-simple::verify_simple()`** at `pkix-chain-simple/src/lib.rs:478` — opinionated extension-whitelist variant.
- **`Profile` → `ValidationPolicy`** indirection: `BasicTlsProfile::policy()` produces a `ValidationPolicy` with `required_leaf_eku = Some(vec![ID_KP_SERVER_AUTH]) + require_subject_alt_name = true`. `BasicSmimeProfile::policy()` sets `ID_KP_EMAIL_PROTECTION + require_rfc822_san`. Inside `validate_path`, EKU OID match enforced at `pkix-path/src/lib.rs:3091–3118`; SAN presence at `:3085–3088` and `:3126–3134`.
- **Callbacks already plumbed:** `SignatureVerifier` trait is the algorithm-specific seam; `RevocationChecker` trait is the per-cert revocation callback. These are the mozilla::pkix-style "TrustDomain" I'd been treating as an open design question.
- **End-to-end test green** at `pkix-chain/tests/e2e.rs:42` (`e2e_verify_chain_default_pkits_4_1_1`) — PKITS chain validates.
- **CA/B Forum profile variants** in `pkix-profiles-cabf` (WebPkiProfile, SmimeProfile tiers, CodeSigningProfile) feed the same `ValidationPolicy`/`verify_chain` pipeline.

**The actual gap is identity binding.** The workspace cannot today answer "is this cert valid for `example.com`?" because no code anywhere takes a hostname (or mailbox) and matches it against the leaf's SAN. Workspace-wide grep returns only doc comments expressing intent and the unrelated nameConstraints-side matcher (`dns_name_matches_constraint` at `pkix-path/src/lib.rs:2190`, which matches SAN-against-issuer-constraint, not SAN-against-caller-target).

Specifically missing:

- **RFC 6125 dNSName binding** — hostname comparison against SAN `GeneralName::DnsName` entries, wildcard rules (single leftmost label, no embedded wildcards), IP literal handling, IDN.
- **RFC 5280 §4.2.1.6 + RFC 8398 mailbox binding** — mailbox comparison against SAN `GeneralName::Rfc822Name` entries; internationalized local-part via SmtpUTF8Mailbox otherName; case-folding rules.
- **Per-use ergonomic wrappers** — `verify_tls_server(chain, anchors, hostname, ...)`, `verify_smime_signer(chain, anchors, mailbox, ...)`, `verify_code_signer(chain, anchors, ...)`, etc. — composing `verify_chain` with new identity-binding code.

## What this epic now scopes

After revision, 5 children close as superseded (architecture already shipped) and 6 children rescope to narrower questions. The substantive remaining work is identity binding + per-use wrappers + their differential testing.

**Closed as superseded (already shipped):**

- `.1` — composable-policy architecture ratification. Architecture (`Profile` → `ValidationPolicy` → `verify_chain` consuming `SignatureVerifier` + `RevocationChecker` callbacks) is already production code. No ratification needed; future work extends, not replaces.
- `.4` — `RevocationMode` granularity. `RevocationChecker::check_revocation(cert, issuer)` is per-cert by design (called in a loop at `pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:172–181`). Decision resolved by inspection.
- `.8` — `VerificationPolicy` trait + `PathContext` + `Finding` types. `Profile`/`ValidationPolicy`/`ValidatedPath`/`Error` already serve this. No new foundational types needed.
- `.9` — `verify()` orchestrator. `verify_chain()` at `pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:156` IS the orchestrator. Existing API stays.
- `.10` — `policies::rfc5280_baseline` + `policies::revocation`. These checks are integral parts of `validate_path` + `verify_chain`, not separable policies.

**Rescoped (narrower than original):**

- `.2` — was "TrustDomain callback vs upfront-inputs." Most of that question is answered (the SignatureVerifier + RevocationChecker callbacks are shipped). Narrowed to: **add AIA-fetch callback for online intermediate retrieval?**
- `.5` — was "VerifyReport shape." Current shape is `Result<ValidatedPath, Error>`. Narrowed to: **add a structured findings layer on top?** Optional add-on, not a redesign.
- `.13` — was "code signing / time stamping / OCSP responder policies." Narrowed to: **thin wrappers (verify_code_signer, verify_time_stamper, verify_ocsp_responder) over existing CodeSigningProfile / new TimeStamping/OcspResponder profiles + verify_chain.** No identity binding needed for these.
- `.16` — `VerifyReport` emit. Narrowed to: **Display/Debug impls on ValidatedPath and Error**; structured-findings emit only if `.5` chooses to add findings.
- `.17` — PKITS regression. Narrowed to: **PKITS through the NEW wrappers** (existing `verify_chain` PKITS coverage already in place at `tests/e2e.rs`).
- `.20` — was "verify_chain migration + CHANGELOG." Narrowed to: **CHANGELOG + AGENTS.md updates for new wrappers.** `verify_chain` stays as-is; no migration.

**Unchanged (substantive remaining work):**

- `.3` — Decide identity-binding subsystem location (inline in policies / new `pkix-identity` crate / inside `pkix-profiles`). **Most consequential surviving decision.**
- `.6` — Decide lint integration model.
- `.7` — Decide canonical ergonomic-wrapper set + defaults.
- `.11` — Implement RFC 6125 hostname binding + `verify_tls_server` + `verify_tls_client`.
- `.12` — Implement RFC 5280 §4.2.1.6 / RFC 8398 mailbox binding + `verify_smime_signer` + `verify_smime_recipient`.
- `.14` — Implement `policies::lint_catalog` adapter (or parallel pipeline per `.6`).
- `.15` — Implement ergonomic single-call wrappers (per `.7`).
- `.18` — Differential testing against OpenSSL for hostname/mailbox binding.
- `.19` — Differential testing against pyca for same.

## Acceptance

- All open children closed.
- `pkix-chain` ships at minimum `verify_tls_server(chain, anchors, hostname, time, ...)`. Hostname binding correct per RFC 6125 §6.4 (wildcards, IP literals, IDN, case-insensitive).
- `pkix-chain` ships `verify_smime_signer(chain, anchors, mailbox, time, ...)` with RFC 5280 §4.2.1.6 + RFC 8398 mailbox binding.
- Thin wrappers for code signing / time stamping / OCSP responder (no identity binding).
- Differential testing harness in `pkix-difftest` covers TLS hostname and S/MIME mailbox binding against OpenSSL and pyca.
- AGENTS.md `pkix-chain` description reflects shipped reality (including new wrappers).
- CHANGELOG entries for new APIs.

## Out of scope

- Replacing or restructuring the existing `verify_chain` API. The current shape stays.
- A `VerificationPolicy` trait stack. The existing `Profile` → `ValidationPolicy` indirection already does composition at the right layer.
- Choosing a wire format for policy data (deferred to PKIX-ncab cleanup).
- `pkix-ac`, `pkix-ct`, `pkix-composite` skeleton crates.
- FIPS-mode specifics.

## Audit reference

Full code-state audit (file:line citations for every component) recorded by an explore subagent on 2026-05-11. The audit findings are summarized at the top of this description.
